en: [getting annoyed] Excuse me, but it's left with us a name, maybe the name, the Crooked Man.
That's not good enough.
We... haven't been doing a good job. And I don't just mean Crane, I mean us, personally.
Well, if that's the case... please explain to Colin why ripping Gren's arm off was necessary.
Toad's apartment's destroyed, and we beat him up for trying to protect his son.
Innocent people have been hurt by us. The Woodsman, Gren...
The funeral, Holly... Faith...
So... starting now... we do everything cut and dried, by the book, straight as an arrow.
I'm not saying I'm the arbiter of--[cuts off]
[biting] Pure as driven snow...
Hey, none of that was Bigby's fault.
"Capable" of doing? Nobody else is crazy enough to--[stops herself]
[sarcstic] Sure you're not.
Just... promise me, promise me that that... side of you is done. Okay?
Whatever you think is best.[beat] You're the Deputy Mayor.
I sleep a little safer at night knowing Bigby has that in his back pocket.
Well that makes one of us.
We need monsters to fight monsters.
Colin, if I really believed that we needed him to lose his flippin' mind at a moment's notice...
Then that would mean I'd lost all faith in our ability to help this town.
Look, believe me, I hate to be the one to defend him here, but...
You're just holding up everything to chastise Bigby for doing what no one else was capable of doing--
That it's done and buried and we can all move on...
This town has enough monsters.
I had no other choice!
Easy for you to say.
Degrees? I only ever do what's necessary.
[cold] Really?
Well if that's the case... please explain to Colin why tearing Dum's throat out was necessary.
The fight wasn't over!
It's what I do, okay?
I got out of control.
I'm sure whatever happened, happened for a reason.
Bigby doesn't owe me an explanation.
He was... he was still a threat, and that's all there is to it.
[cold] Sure.
Because I fucking felt like it, okay? I wanted to destroy something.
No, Bigby, it isn't.
That's a good first step.
I can admit that it went too far.
Yeah. I do.
Do you believe him?
This town has enough monsters. What happened last night... what you turned into... it can't happen again.
Be done and buried and we can all move on...
Just let that side of you be done, okay?
Look, I'm sorry that I have to bring all this up, but... I think it's important.
Is that what you want to hear?
But you sit behind a desk... all day... and only tonight did you see what it's like to be pushed into a corner all the time just for doing your job.
I'm sure from your vantage point, it's extraordinarily easy to judge me.
There are degrees.
We were under attack, Snow. What did you expect me to do?
I know what it's like, and I know what it's like to lie to yourself... to justify what you've done.
You think I don't know what's it like to have my life in danger? To not be pushed to do things...[stops herself]
Right, exactly. Thank you.
I'll do better.[beat] We'll do better.[beat] We have to be better than them, or... what's the point?
So for that you wanna give him a handicap? Like the bad guys will worry if shit gets sloppy?
It's just that... now that I'm Deputy Mayor, I need your respect.
I care about how this is done, okay? I care about how this is done just as much as I care about it getting done.
Everybody wants Bigby to smile and shave and take a shower now and then... Hell, I'm practically the President of the "Bigby, Don't Be Such A Dick" Club...
But get it done "right."
He'll get the job done, just let him do it.
I'm going to-- [stops herself; turns from Colin to Bigby]I'm going to let you "do it", okay?
Like with Greenleaf's tree.[beat] You can't argue with me about this stuff.
Like you thinking Crane is the murderer.[beat] You can't argue with me about this stuff.
It's not your place.
You've had this job for, what--
Five hours now?
It doesn't matter if I've had it five minutes.
You get what I'm saying, right?
Not my place?!
[annoyed] I never saw myself having a place...
I chose the wrong word, I'm sorry. But you have to understand where I'm coming from.
What happened to teamwork?
We are.[beat] But there's an order here, and I think things will go better if we follow it.
I thought we were a team, Snow.[beat] I thought we were in this together.
Disagreements will happen.
Look, sometimes we'll disagree, it's not a big deal.
Yes, it is. You can't get a vote, it can't work that way, nothing will ever get done.
Well I sure as fuck don't.
But this is the wrong fucking time to put shackles on him.[beat] He'll get the job done, just let him do it.
All unglamoured Fables - starting today - have to go and stay at The Farm.
Oh, give me a fuckin' break!
And this situation... has to end.
Are you gonna let her talk to me like that?
[getting angry] What situation?
They know what a pig is! It's not the end of the world!
I'm a pig, not a mouse with a hat and a cane!
And what if a mundy does see me, huh?
And Bigby knows it's for the best of the town.
It's been the rule for a reason, Colin...
It keeps everybody out of trouble.
Look, everyone just calm down, alright?
I'm not! Tell me right now: what's it gonna be, Bigby?
I'm perfectly calm.
If you would simply get a glamour...
"Get a glamour?" With what money? You think I can work? I don't even have thumbs.
[shocked] What? Are you kiddin' me?
If Snow says that's the way it's gotta be, that's the way it's gotta be.
Yes, it will.
There's not that many stragglers left... except the one or two you make excuses for.
It's an impossible rule to enforce, Snow. You really expect to round up every talking cat and raven in town?
[decisive] That's not gonna happen.
[sarcastic] Thanks for the support.
[hugely annoyed] Are you gonna answer that or what?
[annoyed] The phone?
[annoyed] Bigby?
[answering the phone] What is it.
[processed: phone] Hello, Mr. Bigby, sorry to bother you, but is Miss White there?
[answering Bigby's phone] Wolf's residence.
What? We're talking here.
[muttering to himself] That's rude.
Bufkin, what is it?
[into phone]Oh, Bufkin, what is it?
Guess who's waiting in your office right now?
[sighs] Yes. Apparently she told Bufkin that she has something she needs to talk to you about... but that she'll only tell you.
[into phone] That's weird.
Nerissa?
And what do you think that could be?
[into phone] Okay, I'll be right--[stops herself; listens] Oh.[beat] Really?
[into phone]Okay, I'll let him know. Thanks.
Nerissa.
The Crooked Man.
A dead body.
Some help, I hope.
How should I know?
[blase; tired] A dead body, I dunno.
[tired] Hopefully some help.[beat] Who is it.
Snow, honestly... how should I know.
It's Nerissa.
You always do well with the, uh, disenfranchised.
Something about your prickly demeanor attracts them like a moth to a flame.
Awwww, Bigby's got an admirer.
She probably just wants to talk about last night. The whole thing at the Pudding N' Pie.
Maybe she does.
She knows something...[beat] She's helped me a little with the case, maybe she has something else.
[shruggingly] Okay.
I haven't the slightest.
I should get back to the Business Office, I've left Bufkin alone for too long taking calls.
Consider the discussion tabled, but not over.
Let me know when you're done with Nerissa.
Aye aye, Captain.
[muttering] Yeah.
She's a piece of work.
I mean...
Right?
But I can still hang out here...
She seemed real serious about it.
Oh, okay. I get it.
I don't know...[beat] Snow will come around. She's just...
The Crane thing hit her hard, and... she doesn't really know who her friends are right now.
Bull. Shit.
The rules are the rules. I don't get to make 'em, I just enforce 'em.
Yeah, well I think I ran out.
You give favors all the time, I know you do.
Look, uh, maybe a few will get sent up, but you're my friend, Colin. I wouldn't do that to you.
[glum] After everything we fuckin' been through... you don't have the nerve to give me a straight answer.
{NormalB}I just can't forget everything he's done,{AngryD} I don't care if he has "problems" with the Crooked Man...
{SadA}It's not about Crane anymore, Bigby.
{thinkingA}But it's not like we had a strong choice in the matter.
{SadA}	We're all mad about it, Colin...
Or should I be asking her, now that she's... you know...
So don't talk to me like I'm other people.
It's "crooked" in the sense that... you can't draw a straight line from it to anywhere else.[beat] It's... warped, twisted... off a few degrees.
The only thing we had in the books about him was that the Crooked Man lives in the Crooked Lane... but as far as I can tell that's not an actual place.
Look, Bigby, just... what's the plan here, exactly?
[cold] {ThinkingA}We'll all get some rest when this whole thing is done.
Or should I be askin' her, now that she's... you know....
{AnnoyedB}I mean, do you guys have like a plan or somethin'...?
{Sarcastic}What "whole thing"? {angryA}What's even happenin' out there?
{angryA}And who should I be asking?
{WorriedA}	[You're not pissed]Or that the Crooked Man thinks he's got Snow under his thumb?
You guys folded like a cheap suit. {normalA}That's the way it looked, at least.
Yesterday it was Crane, Crane, Crane. We were so...[stops herself; sighs]
[getting annoyed] Excuse me, but it got us Crane.
And he's gone now.
That broad from the Pudding N' Pie?
[frustrated][heated]{angryA}Could I get some quiet in here?
Can I please get some quiet?!
{mockingA}	Hm. Not bad. That'll do, I suppose.
{professional} The Tweedles... Bloody Mary... Miss White said that they are merely the blade. Not the hand that wields it. Hm?
[confused][groggy]{druggedA}I know I'm a little fuzzy here, but... what?
You can't let up until the fight is finished.
Crane isn't the only one who's broken the people's trust...
We haven't been doing a good job. [beat]You and I.
cs_enter: Bigby wakes from the fight, Swineheart operates, Snow watches, Colin hangs back
cs_snowTalk: Swineheart packs his things and talks to Snow.  Bigby helplessly observes the pair talk about him.
cs_snowTalk (Anyways): Swineheart departs.  Bigby (Shirtless) makes his way towards the kitchen.
cs_snowTalk (IntimateStart): Bigby grabs a beer from the fridge and Snow turns from talking with Colin toward Bigby.
cs_snowTalk (StoppedBreathing): Bigby and Snow have a "moment" in the kitchen entry before Colin ruins it.
cs_snowRecap: Snow walks away from Bigby and Colin as she begins to talk about the Crooked Man.
cs_snowDirectives: Bigby (and his beer) have a seat as the tension between Colin and Snow ramps up.
cs_snowDirectives2 (GonnaAnswerThat): Snow walks to the phone and answers.
cs_snowDirectives2(final exchange): Snow tries to brush a bit of the mess off herself and leaves.
cs_snowLeaves: Bigby walks towards the door, has his exchange with Colin, and then leaves.
cs_snowLeaves (ExitTime): Bigby opens the door to his office, revealing Nerissa waiting.  We'll get a flat for the interior of the office once we've got the shot figured out.
